memory_measurement: OS child process high-water RSS, entire routine including imports, preparation, retained weekly panel and fit/inference. Fresh measurement process with this sole child. Not parent+child aggregate or memory of AI analysis.

host.host_ram_assumption: No assumption that measured host has 8 GB

compute_compatibility.scope: Supplied 5 MB transaction CSV, 17,406 rows; 65,330 weekly panel rows, 336 series. No ensemble or GPU. Selected method holds panel, small per-series arrays and daily forecasts; measured child peak compared with 8 GB, allowing several GB for OS. More history/assortment scales with total series-weeks, and must be remeasured at materially larger input size.
compute_compatibility.analysis_build_cost: Not measured or inferred from local routine runtime; AI-assisted build separate.

measurement_limits: One local warm-filesystem run, not a hardware-independent speed guarantee.
RSS is resident high-water, not total virtual allocation; OS overhead and other applications excluded.
fit/inference split excludes data preparation; whole-child wall/RSS includes it.
